paper: Video as Natural Augmentation: Towards Unified AI-Generated Image and Video Detection (arXiv 2605.21977)
training_set_in_paper: VINA (140k+DDA): the 140k video set (from Qwen2.5-ViT) plus DDA's image data, DINOv3-L fine-tuned end to end with a cross-modal supervised contrastive loss (weight 0.05) next to BCE; one frame per video clip, 256x256, AdamW, 10 epochs, lr 1e-6, batch 64 (paper section 4.1). Only the released checkpoint VINA_DINOv3-L_140k+DDA.pth is evaluated here (the registry keys vina for images and vina_video for the paper's video protocol); the training code is not released, so there is no SynthScope-trained checkpoint. SynthScope numbers are the official pooled accuracy per subset (the _offmetric tags), the paper's metric.

benchmarks.name: ForenSynths (CNNDetection test, the paper's 11 subsets)
benchmarks.metric: pooled accuracy per subset at 0.5 (the official code's metric), mean over subsets; AP mean over subsets

paper_number.note: Table 12 (mean ACC / AP over 11 subsets; Table 10 prints AP 97.77).

our_number.note: 86.93 ACC / 97.80 AP on the official extension set (90,310 files; the 19 SAN .bmp reals are not listed by the official CSV builder), -0.06 / +0.02; 10 of 11 subsets equal, SAN 83.05 / 95.44 vs 83.79 / 95.16. A reconstruction that keeps the .bmp reals as black images gives 86.99 / 97.77 (SAN equal); that is inferred, not the headline. The balanced mean on those files is 86.98 / 97.80 (bacc field of vina_cnndetection_offmetric); all 13 folders through bench_eval give 88.27 / 97.95 (vina_cnndetection). Tags vina_cnndetection_offmetric, vina_cnndetection_bmpblack_offmetric; job 281655.
